description.value: Quiznos is a Canadian fast-food sandwich chain specialising in toasted subs, sliders, flatbreads, and salads. This Richmond location is part of a national network that offers online ordering and a catering service. The menu spans meat-heavy classics through to a vegetarian guacamole option, making it a serviceable calorie stop on a cycling route.
